title: RISE Live: collection imagery (astronomy and landscapes) in the room
acceptance: The owner decides the design in docs/plans/LIVE-IMAGERY.md: Option A (a collection is an engine; RISE chooses the work) or B (subject facets), and the open questions of its section 7 that the first slice needs (the chip's text, the collection's name).
@scene <id> astronomy is read by the segment parser, admitted, and lowered to { kind: 'sourced', collections: ['sci-astronomy'] }; a parameter on it is refused.

In the venue a reading with that scene shows an astronomy work in the full frame, never the inner eye or the shell; under reduced motion at once. The previous visual holds until the image decodes, and a failed image never leaves a black or broken frame.

The chip shows every credit-required work's credit and licence as text; at 1440x900 and 390x844 its box lies inside the room's safe rectangle and meets neither the words' zone, the ask bar, the docked face nor the sign-in link (measured in a browser test).
About this reading lists each picture shown with title, full credit, licence and source link, so the credit rulings hold in a room with no door to the Curia.

The catalog words answer 'astronomy' at once with no model call; the first-load budget and the security policy are unchanged; Composer's guide does not offer the collection until the card can show it.
Human gate: the owner watches a real model's reading that uses the collection on the deployed /live, in the dark room and the light room.

evidence.note: Design only, branch live-imagery-design. Agent measurements, not human observations: the astronomy catalog holds 216 works (ESA/Hubble 98, NASA 64, ESO 54), landscapes 216 pins (Rijksmuseum 178, Cleveland 38); sampled ESA/ESO screen images are 1280 px wide and 138-251 KB, NASA's catalog files 640 px; the MCP card admits images from RISE's origin only; Cleveland's keyless API totals 458 CC0 landscape paintings and 145 CC0 landscape photographs. Nothing built.

activity.summary: Design written on branch live-imagery-design for the owner's decision: what exists, three options and a recommendation, the landscapes curation plan, the first slice and the owner's questions

summary: Show RISE's reviewed collections (Astronomy now, Landscapes next) in the Live room's full frame with their credits. The frames already admit a museum image; the gap is that a Live reading cannot ask for one. Design awaiting the owner's decision; first slice is astronomy on /live only.
